text: So I came in with a table for 7. The host was rude right when we walked up to get in line. Instead of directing us on how they are running right now he just let other people get infront of us and wrote their name down. I don't know if they are all just pissy because of the mask or if they don't like their jobs. Our server Devin was so polite and nice but everyone else working tonight has terrible attitudes and customer service skills. We got told we cannot order shots at bar for table and the bartender had attitude and just walked away instead of letting our server know we wanted the shots. Should have went to any other of the 100 places open on this street. Won't be back.

Good food.
Nice bacon.
Good cold brew.
Nice choice of music.
Will defiantly go again.
The food was great and the waiters were helpful and kind, especially Sean. He made us all feel welcome and made us all laugh. Highly recommend!

The drinks were all superb. I mean above and beyond. I really enjoyed some of the unique offerings on their menu. The food was..okay. It was more of a tapas menu that was offered and nothing really stood out. Especially not for the pricing and portion. For example I ordered the octopus that was maybe around the $15 mark and I received one small, thin, 3in. tentacle and it was ...ok. I've had far better, this was my least favorite. But nothing else we ordered would incite me to return which is a bummer as I heard wonderful hype about this place. It's possible they weren't offering their normal menu because of covid things? But the service was just ok as well. Overall a high bill for small amounts of mediocre food. 5 stars for drinks, maybe a 2 for the dining. Bummer
Had dinner here on a Saturday night.  No wait to sit.  Got a great view of the live music and the food was so good!  Our server Grayson was very friendly and on top of anything we needed.

Ordered a 14" Triple Pie to go. Was really cheesy and full of different bits of meat, not like loaded, but adequate. And I enjoyed the heat, as it was just the right amount I wanted. The crust was really tasty, almost sweet!  Service was very friendly from everyone I encountered. But mainly my five star review is for their homemade ranch dressing. I asked for some to dip my pizza in and guuhhhhhhh....it was DELICIOUS! Made me very, very happy. If you are a ranch dressing fan, this place will deliver. Next time I will try their salad bar

Make sure u check for accuracy of ur orders before leaving- I was missing my drink. 

The food is ok- fast and good variety.
The soup for breadbowl was skimpy but I'll be back

The staff here is extremely friendly and helpful. The food is well cooked and enjoyable. However the sides are extremely small. I also believe it's a little expensive at $7 for a pretty small sandwich. Definitely need to work on the size of the sandwich and besides for the prices they're charging

My friends and I went to the Atlantis spa over the weekend. We would have had a 5 star time if it weren't for the lack of customer service provided by the staff. We got there over an hour early for all of our treatments and the staff acted as if we were a complete burden for them to get all of us set up. They asked us to share lockers. Which would have been fine, but when we asked for one more locker, they acted again as if we were a burden. We weren't offered a tour so we had no idea what was in the spa or where we could relax besides the locker room. After our first treatment, we asked for a tour, and the man giving the tour was completely unenthusiastic and again acted like we were a burden. 
After my first treatment at 11am, the masseuse  mentioned how much I am going to like my next treatment which was at 3. After my last treatment she saw us walking down the hall and said, "Oh, you are STILL here?" Of course I'm still here, you knew that. After paying over a grand to have a relaxing day, I didn't expect everyone to have such a horrible attitude. 
All of my friends said they enjoyed their treatments and we all did have a relaxing day using the other services the spa offered. I just wish the staff was more genuine. 
I liked the Atlantis Spa more than the Peppermill in a few ways, like their therapy lounge is gorgeous and the herbal steam room is better than the Peppermill. But you have to share the pool with the hotel guests which isn't the worst thing, but the Atlantis p

Just had another excellent meal at Mikes. I have so far tried about half the menu and Mike knows what he is doing.  I like his chili and have already had the gumbo about ten times. Also liked his fish and chips and of course the premium hot dogs. The name is little misleading- could be Mikes Cafe
Definitely a little pricey but worth it for the quality + taste. Everything I've tried has been delicious! The woman who owns is also super sweet.

The food here is fantastic! Their veal parm is delicious. I also love the limoncello cake. My only complaint is about the owner/manager. She's very racist. I have friends who have worked there, and they have told me she uses racial slurs and dislikes anyone who is not white. The last time I ate there, she would not stop staring at me. If I didn't know about what she's said behind closed doors, I wouldn't have payed it any mind. It's such a shame. I would keep coming here because the food is spectacular, but I'll just take my money somewhere else.

This is my coworker's go-to place so I've been thinking about going here for quite some time. Darling area of the City! They are building a great community in that area. 

We sat inside because it's a million degrees outside but in hindsight, we should have sat on the shaded patio!! Inside was great too. We had a nice view of the desserts. Plus it was nice and cool! 

I had the Lola's Breakfast Sandwich. It was a scrambled egg, bacon and cheese on a toasted bun. It was very tasty! Just the right amount of eggs, bacon and cheese to make it the perfect egg sandwich. I will most likely order it again the next time I go there. 

It was served with chips or a fruit cup. I selected the fruit cup. The fruit was cut to bite sized pieces and all of it was good. Strawberries, cantaloupe, grapefruit and grapes made up the fruit. Sorry if I'm forgetting one. 

I forgot to snap photos. I'm always a bit too eager for my food. Ha! I did snap some photos of the dessert cases. 

Service was good. They were attentive but not overly attentive. We could carry on a nice conversation without interruptions. 

I look forward to going back to this lovely restaurant. I can see why my coworker goes again and again. 

PS - They were doing a nice job to prevent the spread of Covid.
Great variety of products,  terrible customer service. I asked about a food product and got a shoulder shrug and was told to look in grocery.

Fantastic place. The Sharwama is well cooked and tasty. Portion size is decent as well. Beautiful place as well. They have some lovely tapestries from the Middle East on the walls and the Arabic music playing in the background makes the place immersive.

**This is a COVID restriction-era review**

My parents (& sister on break from college) live in Somersett and have told us how impressed they were with Sakana for Reno sushi. So last night my sister, fiancé and I went for dinner. 

We called ahead of time to make sure they had outdoor seating (they allow indoor, it's just out of my comfortability). They have a nice, covered patio that wraps around two sides of their building and out of the 8-10 (??) tables they had, we were the only ones sitting outside. Note: all you can eat sushi is ONLY available inside! Regular service/regular menu is available outside. We wished they would have had music outside- the ambiance is sad compared to the poppin Tap House next door. 

Our server was wearing a mask (from a nurse, please keep your nose inside of your mask!!!) and was very friendly and attentive. 5 stars for service!

We started with a glass of fume blanc ($8) and sauv blanc ($9)- fiancé gives "10 stars for drink prices"- and we ordered a house salad, gyoza and hamachi kama to share. The hamachi kama wasn't on the menu (Haley saw a yelp review picture) but was $7.99 and very good. We didn't care for the gyoza as it was deep fried, not pan fried as we had assumed. And the biggest disappointment of the night was the $5 house salad. See my pictures for the description of the salad and the small plate of plain cabbage that came out. Literally. Plain. Cabbage. If they ran out of all the other salad ingredients that's fine, but we shoul

First time ordering from Shanghai Bistro and let me tell you, it- was - delicious! One of the best Wor Wonton soups I've ever had, hands down. The house fried rice was delectable and the sesame chicken,
done to perfection. I used their online app to order and set pico up time at 8:30. A gentleman from the restaurant contacted me around then to find out our ETA as the restaurant closed at 8! When my husband arrive to pick pick the gentleman was the only person there and had stayed 30 min past closing so we could pick up our order. Now that's good service! We will be back.

We have driven past this restaurant numerous times and have discussed stopping, but never did till today when we had to be in the center anyway. Wish we had been in the center sooner!

They have a nice patio area and serve alcohol so that already earns them a star. Large menu with salads, soups, burritos, tacos, entrees and an item called machete which is basically like an arepa. 

They also have a salsa bar with numerous options - salsa, avocado cream, cilantro cream, Southwestern dressing, pickled onions and veggies, cabbage, cucumbers and more. 

You order at counter but they bring food to you, fairly quickly. Good portion sizes and food is very flavorful
This place was pretty dirty. their menu was all over the place. there was a longass wait for a simple esquite. also i swear i saw a roach and i aint talkin bout that gas.

Need educated staff who can count money and who have people skills definitely in need of new employees very rude and tried to keep some of the money when they miscounted the money and caught her in the act she couldn't even look at us after
Great place breakfast lunch great spot downtown TV the salad are made for two of you share  if your on Terrie Verde   Have to stop in for that sandwich for the boat

1st time dining here. Had heard good things. Just stopped in for a quick brunch with my bestie. Place was smaller than I thought, so you can imagine that Sunday brunch was a popular time. All of the dishes passing by my table looked phenomenal and definitely had me wanting to plan another visit to try other items. Today, however, I settled on the Nashville Hot Chicken Biscuit with fries (could have had a salad but hey, I wanted all the fatness today). I also added their cheddar bacon sausage patty. The star of this meal was the sausage patty. It was juicy with a little spicy kick. The biscuit was also good. Thick enough to withstand the weight of the breaded chicken breast and slaw, but not dry. The fries were a tad too salty, but we're golden brown and crispy. I only wished there was more of a seasoning on the chicken breast. Maybe the slaw, pickles and ranch sauce were supposed to make up for the lack of taste with the chicken, but I think a little seasoning would have taken this sandwich over the top. I definitely recommend a visit, make sure to make a reservation if you go for brunch. Can't wait to explore the rest of the menu. Oh, and if you are an eggs and meat person, might I suggest the Ohio Truck Stop dish. Eggs, bacon, hasbrowns, ham, that delicious cheddar bacon sausage, and brioche toast. Yum!

I placed  a Togo order. The guy was super friendly over the phone. Once I got there , no one Acknowledged me .. Finally someone  did come and help me., he was nice but not over the top friendly. You could tell he wasn't happy to be working... the pizza was stiff and not good at all. Not worth the price. 
I use to come all the time., probably won't be back for a while .

We ordered from here last night, and it didn't disappoint. The shrimp scampi was very flavorful. Our son demolished his raviolis. Looking forward to being able to go here soon, but for now we will definitely be ordering from here again.

I'm in town for UNR's graduation as an alumni myself, and I love all the Ijji locations, so when I heard about a new one opening I had to check it out. Unlike the other locations, this one isn't sushi or korean bbq, but a noodle house. The location is nice and modern, the staff are very helpful and attentive when checking out the new food they have to offer. I was recommended to try the black garlic tonkotsu, and man was it tasty. I'm not a real foodie, but it was one of the best meals I've had in Reno. Check it out and don't be afraid to try out something new.

Take your pick from Thai, South American and several others. We had Poke bowls, very fresh, very good. Finished with  Rolled ice cream. Great stuff. This place is like a stand alone food court with full bar.

I love coming here because the staff is so accommodating and passionate about their menu. My go-to is the tuna salad salad which is the best I've had just about anywhere. 

Make sure to save some time to browse all of the UK goodies in their shop! It makes me nostalgic for my trips to London.

Walking by this place you probably wouldn't give it a second look but the mystery was too intriguing to not give it a shot. Friends and I ordered chorizo burrito and the nachos which came quick and still hot. The burrito was HUGE and absolutely delicious and messy but wouldn't want Mexican food any other way. Nachos were fresh and yummy. Definitely will eat again.
Consistently good food even with the recent shutdown of restaurants except for takeout. Everyone working there is pleasant and accommodating.

Stopped in for the first time in a burger mood and saw great reviews thought I would give it a whirl!
Atmosphere is easy and enjoyable with Vid Friendly seating...little surprised with ketchup and salt/pepper shakers on the table.

Service was prompt and knowledgeable and friendly.

The Flamme Burger was cooked well and flavorful and yes was messy good.  Fries were handcut and fried well.  Had the Diablo dipping sauce which paired most excellently with the salty savory fries.

I would return and try other menu items

Eat local Shop Local Live Local JC

This was my second time visiting Country Donuts and it's safe to say, they've got a fan! The first time I visited was a home run- great service, fantastic selection, delicious donuts. This time, the same experience, only it was taken to the next level by the way the 2 ladies working behind the counter professionally handled the man with his 2 kids who blatantly ignored the prominently displayed masking regulations. As I sat in my car this morning, I wondered how it would be handled. I saw the man become increasingly animated as he was told he would need to either wear a mask or leave (as I found out later). He decided to storm out, sans delicious donuts, leaving more for us mask wearing citizens. Thank you to the 2 ladies behind the counter for your part in trying to maintain standards and keep everyone safe. Your act of bravery was seen and noticed. Please keep up the great work and great donuts.

This restaurant took very good care of me on what was my first visit. While I could not have my first choice due to an allergen concern, I had the cali wrap with chicken. Absolutely fresh and delicious! As an added bonus, I was able to have the Cesar side dressing as they use vegan mayo as a base (the dressing itself is not vegan but does not contain egg). 
Also the rice and beans on the side was delicious. 
Hats off to the staff for taking care of me and for providing a great meal.

Yay how amazing the Napoleon house was open when I visited the French quarter. I had the most amazing salad and their new frozen Pims cup, All to go of course. But it was really nice because the French quarter was really clean and quiet and we walked over to the river and sat on a bench and ate our lunch. There were a few shops open so it was kind of nice feeling like we had the French quarter all to ourselves.
Sweet tea! Atmosphere...location. Music. All great. Wasn't impressed with the food, but I imagine the BBQ is on point.

Cute little coffee shop in Boise.  I got the latte that was perfect.  My honey got a drip coffee that was a bit more acidic than she prefers.  All in all a great little place to grab a quick cup of coffee

Didn't expect it but, Jean-Georges Philadelphia was truly excellent. Whatever your in the mood for, they have it. I ordered Tuna Tartare, which was outstanding. It was so flavorful and delicious. The workers were great, I didn't have any issues, everything went smoothly with my order and service. Overall, would definitely come back.

This place is simply great.  Service is spot on. They don't skimp on ingredients and pay attention to the details. Prices are fair and the food is traditional. There can be a wait for Saturday dinner but it's worth the wait.

I'm already a huge fan of Goodfellas (Lexington KY - represent!) and the Broad Ripple location is great for a late night slice before heading home in an Uber but this location has such a cool vibe. Sure, they have your typical pizza counter up front but the coolest part is the lounge-like, speakeasy feel of their bar in the back. Not to mention the bourbon selection is top-notch. As a bourbon drinker, I always appreciate a knowledgeable bartender who makes wholesome suggestions and really knows what type of bourbon you like. Paired with comfy couches and a dim-lit room, this is perfect for a low-key night!

This is the kind of fresh, authentic, reasonably-priced Mexican places that I wish Philly had more of. The food is delicious--large portions, good prices, great flavors. BYOB with tasty mixers. Friendly staff, cute atmosphere. Free chips and salsa. Equally as good for lunch or dinner. Parking in the area can be a pain but it's doable.

Holy not a cannoli! I ordered their full order of biscuits (2 biscuits and gravy) after I had worked all night and had a hankering for a good meal. I have been there many times before but first time ordering this, let me tell you it did not disappoint! Order was hot and fresh and just what I was wanting. I cannot say so many good things about this place and no matter what I have tried it whether it be lunch or breakfast items I have not had anything I didn't like. Along with the food you have the same staff there and they are always so sweet! It can be intimidating from the front looks of the building but TRY IT! It really is a small town diner in a big city with down home cookin'.
it is disaster. the food and the serve. the landlady of the restaurant is unfriendly. i never see anyone like her.well. i will never come here again.
The beet burger is soooo good! The pierogi is even better! Prices are on point, food is fresh and tastes great
Wiping down tables so customers can find a clean place to sit would be nice.  Also, asked for a bread bowl for soup which I didn't get.

Came in for lunch to give glory days another try and definitely better than it was to go, only flaw we had was the Buffalo cauliflower was very tough at the middle and stem. I ate mostly the floret part but middle was undercooked, I told our server flavor was great but it needed 3 more minutes. this fish tacos were great, I love the little pieces of fish, and my sons chicken tender were delicious prefects cooked.
Not bad not good. It was fine. Nothing special. The staff was great and the place was clean and safe and warm. The food was mediocre. Way better options on every corner.

Beware of China House!!
I ordered China House through Door Dash and I usually have no problems. The door dasher delivers the food, she was polite and I had no problems with her. I looked into the bag and none of the food was what we had ordered. Upon calling the restaurant they were rude for no reason, said the Dasher had taken the wrong food and demanded that we bring it back in order to get out food. My mom went and finally found the restaurant and when she brought the food to the counter, the food was snatched from her. My mom tried to explain what had happened and what she had been told to do and instead of responding in any type of manner that would have been acceptable. My mom was yelled at, cursed at, and then threatened. My mom simply stood there while she was being yelled at and kept asking them calmly why they were yelling at her and how now all she wanted was her money back. Soon the owner called the cops on her for no other reason than that and the matter was "resolved". I contacted DoorDash about this whole situation, the company representative was very apologetic and was able to issue a refund to my mom's card without any fuss. Never again will I go to China House, if I could they would zero stars! iI can't say that I tried the food but if it is anything like their employees then I know it is disgusting.

I've always wanted to try Nashville Hot Chicken. Since I'm probably not going to be in Nashville any time soon, I'm glad I found this place. Located in Armature Works, this places adds a nice southern flair to this increasingly multicultural food hall. This meal comes with a side of house made chips, pickles, and pickled red onions along with 2 pieces of white toast. The fried chicken is a chicken leg quarter that has a deliciously crispy exterior paired with a nice moist interior. The spice on this chicken is just right. Spicy but not mind blowing hot. Paired with the pickles and white bread, everything is in good harmony. Wash that down with a cup of sweet tea and there you have a very quintessential southern meal. I think my only qualms about this place is the price. I understand that it's in Armature Works but the price is rather high for not a lot of food. Additionally, no drink is included, meaning getting a drink is a further up charge. I think overall I enjoy the quality, but they can always play around with the pricing and quantity of food still.

Came here twice. First time was a random Saturday and evidently they were closed. Slightly frustrating that they don't have a website or even someone in charge of posting on Yelp that they're temporarily closed. 

When we returned when they were open, we ordered brisket, pork belly, ribs, potato salad, and Mac n cheese. The fatty pieces of brisket were ah-MAY-zing!! Very reminiscent of the bbq we used to get in Texas. I would've liked to see similar options here as well, the ability to order extra moist (fatty), moist (semi-fatty), and lean, instead of whatever is available. Pork belly is limited, and we were one of the last people able to order it around noon on a Saturday. It was superb, definitely worth a try if you love an uber-crunchy texture. The ribs were a tad dry for us, not fall-off-the-bone tender or particularly juicy. Same goes for the Mac n cheese. The potato salad was surprisingly good, not overpowered by the taste of mayo or celery. All in all, a very solid bbq joint that we will be returning to. 

Don't be deterred by the crowd; they turn over orders quickly and the free beer while you wait is a very nice touch. Street parking wasn't too hard for us to find just around the corner from the restaurant.

Wow terrible service. Ordered a pizza through Uber eats. It took over an hour and half to deliver. Called multiple times and was given the run around about where the pizza was. Then it was delivered (through Uber eats).  I ordered 4 pizza and two were delivered.  Driver just said "sorry bro". Called Grimaldi's back and was given the run around again.  Unbelievable frustrating. Grimaldi's made no ever to make it right.  I will never order from them again.  The pepperoni wasn't cooked either. Nice job Grimaldi's. "Gerard" was the most unprofessional person I've ever dealt with at a restaurant.

Chai Yo Staff:  Your fried rice used to be our favorite.   We ordered it today and it was NOT good, PLEASE correct this.   There is no flavor, no ingredients really to speak of besides rice and chicken....   There used to be so much flavor on this dish...   Very disappointed.
